question: Ramkrishna Talukdar received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2018 for his contribution to the Sattriya dance form. To which state does this dance form belong?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sattriya **dance form belongs to the state of **Assam,** which is in the northeastern part of India.
 
• **Ramkrishna Talukdar is a renowned Sattriya dancer and choreographer who has made significant contributions to the development and promotion of this dance form.**
 
• **Sattriya is a classical dance form that originated in the Vaishnav monasteries or satras of Assam in the 15th century.**
 
• It is characterized by graceful movements, i**ntricate footwork, and expressive gestures** that depict stories from Hindu mythology and the life of Lord Krishna.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak** belongs to **Uttar Pradesh.**

 
 
• The tradition holds that the storytellers, or **Kathakars**, who traveled throughout ancient northern India, are the source of Kathak.
 
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam** belongs to **Tamil Nadu.**
 
 
• **It conveys spiritual concepts and religious themes from South India, mostly related to Shaivism and Hinduism in general.**
 
 
 
• **Manipuri** dance belongs to **Manipur.**
 
 
• It is among the greatest cultural accomplishments of the **Meitei people of Manipur,** who practice traditional Vaishnavism.
